A WORLD ABOVE YOU

Headphones on. Going up.

Start at the surface. Scroll up toward space, or down through soil, ocean trenches and Earth’s interior. Pause for a discovery, listen to a recording, or use the arrows to find your next stop.

Try sliding the piano window, brushing the mist or knocking on the elevator glass. Hover over caves to reveal mineral details, or over the ocean to stir gentle illustrated ripples. On touchscreens, tap to explore; keyboard users can focus the illustrations. These playful effects are illustrations, not measurements. Some scenes are quiet; others share real recordings or habitat ambience.

The journey brings together places around Earth. This is a composite depth tour, not a single physical shaft. Labels distinguish sea-level depths, local ground depths and approximate Earth-interior layers. Beyond drilling depths, scenes are scientific reconstructions; quiet exhibits do not imply that the real environment is silent. Atmosphere readings apply above the surface only.
